verdict.rationale: Whether source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing showing Discord's client or server source is available under an open license. The only GitHub item is the discord-api-spec repository, which publishes an OpenAPI description of the HTTP API, not the product's source, and states no license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
